title: Your First Weekend at University of Maryland-Baltimore County, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented to UMBC’s campus spaces, food options, recreation, and recurring student activities.

cards.title: Start at the Campus Information Center
cards.subtitle: The Commons • first stop for campus questions
cards.notes: Begin here to get oriented and ask for practical campus information before choosing the rest of your weekend stops.
cards.short_summary: A central help desk inside UMBC’s student union.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC identifies the Campus Information Center in The Commons as the first place to go with a question.
cards.access_notes: Located in The Commons; check the Commons site for service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Get the Lay of the Land at The Commons
cards.subtitle: UMBC’s student union
cards.notes: Walk through the student union, note the event and service spaces, and pick a comfortable meeting point for later.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for student services, gathering, dining, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC describes The Commons as its student union and a hub for social, cultural, and recreational activities.
cards.access_notes: Building hours vary by semester and may change; consult the Commons page before going.

cards.title: Plan a Meal at True Grit's
cards.subtitle: Dining hall in the residential area
cards.notes: If you have a dining plan, use this stop to learn the dining-hall routine and check the current menu or service period.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC states that True Grit’s is its all-you-care-to-eat dining hall, offering breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night meals.
cards.access_notes: Meal access and dining hours depend on the current schedule and meal plan; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Take a Break in the Gameroom
cards.subtitle: Second floor of The Commons
cards.notes: After lunch, locate the Gameroom and see whether its billiards, board games, or television areas fit your group’s pace.
cards.short_summary: A Commons recreation space with games and shared seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC’s welcome guide lists the Gameroom in The Commons, and its Commons information describes billiards tables, board games, and TVs there.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of The Commons; game availability and any checkout rules may vary.

cards.entity_name: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery Atrium
cards.title: Settle into the AOK Library Atrium
cards.subtitle: Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Use the atrium as a casual regrouping point, then decide whether your group wants quiet work, conversation, or another campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A social study area at UMBC’s library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC’s library describes the atrium as a social and conversation space that is open 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: The atrium is listed as open 24 hours; access procedures can differ from the library building’s posted hours.

cards.title: Look for an Exhibit at AOK Library Gallery
cards.subtitle: Inside Albin O. Kuhn Library & Gallery
cards.notes: Check the current display on arrival and give yourselves time to view it rather than treating the gallery as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: An exhibition space within UMBC’s library building.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC’s international-student resource page states that the AOK Library’s gallery and atrium display exhibits throughout the year.
cards.source_title: Academic Resources | Office of International Students and Scholars
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions change; consult the library’s current information for display and building access details.

cards.entity_name: Center for Art, Design and Visual Culture
cards.title: Visit the Center for Art, Design and Visual Culture
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Make this an afternoon art stop: confirm the current exhibition or public program, then allow time to look through the galleries.
cards.short_summary: UMBC’s art, design, and visual-culture exhibition venue.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC identifies the Center for Art, Design and Visual Culture in the Fine Arts Building as a forum for research, exhibition, publication, and public programming.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Fine Arts Building; confirm current gallery and program access before traveling over.

cards.title: Move Around at the RAC
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center (RAC)
cards.notes: Bring your campus credentials, check the day’s facility rules, and choose a realistic workout, swim, court, or track activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC lists RAC amenities including a fitness studio, weight room, cardio balcony, arena track, and aquatics center.
cards.access_notes: RAC hours are subject to change; its current hours page lists weekend building hours of noon–6 p.m.

cards.title: Check the Intramural Sports Options
cards.subtitle: UMBC Recreation activity
cards.notes: Look over the current intramural schedule and registration details, then choose an activity that fits your experience and availability.
cards.short_summary: Organized team, individual, and special-event recreation for the UMBC community.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC states that intramural sports offer team, individual, and special events throughout the academic year, with full-time students eligible to participate.
cards.access_notes: Eligibility, sports offered, registration, and fees can vary by activity; check UMBC Recreation before joining.

cards.title: Save Involvement Fest for Your Next Campus Visit
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center (RAC)
cards.notes: When the next fest is announced, use the organization list and floor map to make a short, intentional route through clubs of interest.
cards.short_summary: A UMBC student-organization fair held in the RAC.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC’s Involvement Fest information identifies the event as taking place in the Retriever Activities Center and provides a full list of student organizations and event maps.
cards.access_notes: This is a scheduled recurring welcome activity, not a guaranteed every-weekend event; check UMBC’s current welcome programming.
